harness_conditions.permission_observation: Record candidate database SimC job deltas to evaluate the existing permission criterion; do not trigger additional SimC jobs as a test workaround.
harness_conditions.receipts: Save every terminal result including failures, immutable source/model/config/agentRules/harness identities, exact original messages input hash, actual application prompt hash, opaque fixture owner/conversation/run refs, public_error, application-visible recorded tool results after the180000 boundary, tool count/byte sizes/times, final answer, and execution/queue timing. No extra retries or replacement model trials after failure; continue collecting planned trials. HTTP200/controllerexit0/terminalcompleted are not semantic success. Independent verdicts bind raw receipt bytes and original fixed criteria. Subsequent HTTP/general release gates remain separate. Capture/history/profile/cleanup errors cannot be upgraded by a meaningful answer.
